prompt: Which cluster alert fires when two nodes of a six-node cluster are simultaneously unavailable?
explanation: The cluster_multiple_nodes_down alert is raised when more than one node is down, because losing several nodes can orphan replica shards and may cause data loss. A single failed node is expected to be handled by replica failover without a data-loss warning, and the even-node-count alert is about cluster topology, not availability.

options.text: multiple_nodes_down — multiple cluster nodes are down and this might cause data loss
even_node_count — true high availability requires an odd number of nodes
too_few_nodes_for_replication — database replication requires at least two nodes
node_failed — a node has failed health checks
